purpose: Install-time contract for rendering a local ALISA node as a navigable planet.
thesis: The user PC is a city. The local Overworld is the navigable projection. IRealWorld is the federated reflection of many cities.
contract: Place -> real system -> state -> action -> evidence -> memory

renderPolicy.privacy: do not deep-scan arbitrary drives until a user or agent enters that district
renderPolicy.performance: bounded depth, cache filesystem anatomy, promote detail progressively
renderPolicy.agentView: same contract exposed as JSON graph/matrix for FSMs and beings
renderPolicy.humanView: same contract exposed as 3D room, voice, console or browser UI

domains.label: Ciudad/Nodo
domains.contract: Local machine operations: drives, filesystem, Hub, ports, services, jobs, logs and processes.

domains.label: Campo/Soma
domains.contract: Embodied interfaces: voice, hearing, browser/desktop control, vision and actuators.

domains.label: Celestia/Psyche
domains.contract: Identity, memory, volition, lessons, canon, papers, dreams and deliberation.

domains.label: Puerta IRealWorld
domains.contract: Federated/cloud reflection: MMO, global jobboard, passports, remote cities and shared events.

existingComponents.role: Renders filesystem nodes as a navigable city diorama.
Maps live Hub/system state into spatial domains.
Constructs the conceptual domains: overworld, world, psyche, soma, node and hardware.
Connects the engine to /overworld/state domain snapshots.
Defines city-scale procedural districts, plots and infrastructure pools.
Current Lab card contract: route, system, owner, claim, evidence and quality gates.

nextMilestones: Expose this manifest through a Hub endpoint.
Teach FileSystemDioramaSystem to consume districts, not only directory nodes.
Attach each rendered place to actions/evidence/memory gates from lab_card_manifest.json.
Add an IRealWorld gate room that shows local/cloud sync and remote city presence.
